source_conversation.content: Hi, I am going away from December 1 to December 8 and I would like Gmail on my PC to send an automatic reply to people who email me while I am gone. Is it possible to make the reply go only to people in my contacts? If so, how do I set that up?

candidates.decision_basis: The user states Gmail on a PC and asks for a vacation reply with a date range and an option limited to contacts. The setup steps include the optional contacts-only box, and the conditions section gives the start and end times of the reply.
candidates.target:
Here is how to set this up in Gmail on your computer:
1. Open **Gmail** on your computer.
2. At the top right, click the **Settings** icon, then click **See all settings**.
3. On the **General** tab, scroll to the **Vacation responder** section.
4. Select **Vacation responder on**.
5. Enter a date range, a subject, and a message.
6. Optional: To send replies only to your contacts, check the box below the message.
7. At the bottom of the page, click **Save Changes**.
Your automatic reply starts at 12:00 AM on the start date and ends at 11:59 PM on the end date, unless you end it earlier.
candidates.author_note: Cover: open Gmail on the computer, Settings icon then See all settings, General tab, Vacation responder section, select Vacation responder on, enter date range subject and message, optional contacts-only checkbox, Save Changes. Date and time condition kept. Contacts option is optional and must stay marked optional.
